summary.text: Refinement water is seawater Long Hair Ancestor created in his late years toward a man-made secluded domain of heaven and earth.

claims.text: During Heavenly Court’s assault on Lang Ya, the blessed land’s falling seawater looks ordinary but is refinement water that Long Hair Ancestor painstakingly created in his late years. At that time Lang Ya holds only the quantity of one sea. With four seas, a secret method could cause a qualitative change and create a man-made secluded domain of heaven and earth.

When Lang Ya Sect bargains with Fang Yuan, refinement water is listed among assets the sect will not take out to exchange, alongside Long Hair refinement path true meaning, the Long Hair refinement path formation, omnipresent four seas, steal life Immortal Gu, Heavenly Giant Solor, and the agreement with Longevity Heaven.

Facing harmful dao marks and a possible Heavenly Court trap, Fang Yuan has Lang Ya use the refinement path immortal formation, a large amount of rank eight immortal materials, and refinement water to forcefully refine those dao marks. He tells them not to feel pity for the refinement water used. In his previous life he had not known of the refinement path formation or refinement water when he first faced the same problem.

Because a lot of the refinement water is used in that fight, Fang Yuan collects the rest and creates an incomplete Refinement Sea on the most western side of Mini Eastern Sea, close to Mini Central Continent.

Water refinement Immortal Gu at rank eight had been hidden within the refinement water. Lang Ya land spirit used that Gu and other supplementary Gu worms in an immortal killer move to convert the refinement path and water path dao marks of Lang Ya blessed land into refinement water, planning to accumulate enough for it to become the Refinement Sea, a secluded domain that would replenish itself unceasingly. After annexing Lang Ya, Fang Yuan halts that plan and takes the Gu for his own use.

Lang Ya blessed land used killer moves to bias calamities and tribulations toward water path dao marks. Those water path dao marks worked with the refinement path dao marks, creating refinement water. Creating a man-made secluded domain expended a vast number of refinement path and water path dao marks.

In Four Elements Square Regret Blood Refinement Pool, the pool water is the refinement water of the incomplete Refinement Sea mixed with water of the River of Time and processed through refinement path methods with water refinement Immortal Gu as the core.
